steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Alright... I've made note of all of that.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: I can't thank you enough, Vigna.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Don't sweat it! Not much I could help with anyway.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: I couldn't answer any of your questions about Kazdel... Real sorry about that.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: No, that's not the case at all.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: The fact that you were willing to teach me about Sarkaz customs is already a huge help. Thanks to you, I've already learned a lot.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Don't mention it... But, I'll tell you this again. It's whatever since you're on Rhodes Island, but don't assume that all Sarkaz are this easy to talk to!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: If you were in Kazdel, the situation would be different. Completely different!

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Yeah, I get it.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: You clearly don't get it at all! Take Adnachiel for example. Even with how good his temper is, the two of us didn't talk 'til we'd known each other for a long time!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: But in your case, how many days has it been since you joined? When you just casually sauntered up to me for the first time, I thought you had some kind of problem with me!

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Ah, I see. So that was the reason why you were on guard...

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: This is already pretty good, by my standards!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Ugh... Anyway, just be careful out there.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: The way you are right now, I'm real worried that you'll end up dead in a ditch somewhere long before you ever reach Kazdel.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Ahaha... I'll do my best to keep that from happening.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Putting all that aside, thank you for your concern, Vigna.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: (Information on Kazdel is still extremely scant.)

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: (Most of the Sarkaz here with rather moderate attitudes grew up in other countries, and have little understanding of the place as a result.)

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: (However, one thing everyone can agree on is the fact that it's dangerous there. Ugh, it's not sufficiently safe for me to go with Cecelia alone. We can't set off without preparation...)

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: (But, it might be difficult getting any more information, given the status quo.)

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: (Let's see who I can talk to next...)
Coming through.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Oh, certainly. Excuse me...

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: (Wait, no! This guy...!)

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Excuse me!

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: You're the Sarkaz blademaster, Flamebringer...

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: ...I've seen your face on a wanted poster at the Notarial Hall.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: A Sankta, huh? Out for revenge?

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: If it's a fight you want, you've got one. We'll take it outside.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: But step aside first. Wait until I water my flowers.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Plenty of executors and others at the Notarial Hall say it's a pretty bad idea to fight alone when encountering certain targets on the wanted list.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Also, this is Rhodes Island... so I will abide by the rules here.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: Yeah? Suit yourself then.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: (This man... He's...)

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: (He doesn't seem wary of his surroundings in the slightest, and his body is relaxed... He is supremely confident in his combat capabilities.)

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: (He's so focused on the decorative plants that he didn't notice me pulling my gun...)

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: (What an incredibly dangerous individual. However...)

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Uh, Flamebringer, sir... Would you mind if I asked you a few questions?

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: About what?

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: What are you hoping to get out of me?

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: (He's still going about his business, watering his flowers without even pausing for me... It's as if my words mean nothing to him. Of course, not even a hint of anger either...)

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: (Phew... This might be the best chance I'll get.)

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: There are a few things I'd like to ask you about Kazdel.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: I want to know what the reality of the situation is there, like the size of the nearby towns and what kind of people are entering and leaving... I would really appreciate it if gave me some guidance.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: You're going to Kazdel?

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: If you've got a death wish, then go for it.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: It's not a death wish.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: I have my own reasons for needing to go to Kazdel.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: But I'm fully aware that given the current circumstances, setting out right now without making any preparations is tantamount to suicide.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: And I'm not about to do that, which is one of the reasons I've come to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: Uh huh.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: Don't block the light.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Acting recklessly, putting the lives of others and yourself at risk, is not bravery. It's just irresponsible.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: If I can learn as much as possible about the actual situation on the ground before I go, I'll be able to plan ahead and prepare accordingly.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Even though some degree of risk is inevitable, I'd at least like to avoid as much of it as possible.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: You don't have to talk so much.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: Your story's got nothing to do with me, and I'm not interested in your philosophizing.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: Ugh, out of water...

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: Also should get around to pruning these branches and leaves...

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: ...It looks like it's only lush on one side, probably due to uneven light exposure.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Rather than trimming off the unbalanced parts yourself, it might be better to rotate and let the other side get some sunlight.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: Cut off the excess branches and leaves, and the flowers will bloom better.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: The more options you have, the more likely you are to miss the point. That's how it is with plants.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: But... who gets to decide what the 'point' of growth is for another living being?

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: Who?

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: The strong get to decide.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: ...I'm afraid we'll have to agree to disagree on that one, Flamebringer.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: While it's true that this plant, after being pruned, might be more beautiful in appearance and grow more of its eagerly-awaited flowers...

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: I believe that a living being with a consciousness should be free to decide how it wishes to grow.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: Huh?
The Sarkaz blademaster utters a single, absent-minded syllable.
His work does not stop once, during the course of Ezell's lengthy questioning.
When the watering can is empty, he sets it aside for the time being and starts pruning the overgrown branches and leaves.
Now, he conveniently keeps the shears next to the pruned potted plants.

In a heartbeat, the glint from the knife's blade slices through the inch of sunlight shining on the flowers. Ezell slams his back against the wall, hard, the sharp blade grazing his cheek before lodging into the wall behind him.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Urgh–!

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: A silver tongue's not gonna save you.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: What about now?

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: Do you still have a reason to go?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Vigna, why are you so late today?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Sorry, I stopped to chat with someone on the way here, and it ended up taking a while.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Oh... It was Mister Ezell, right?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: That's right. How'd you know, Hibiscus?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Because I was the one who sent him your way.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: That Sankta guy came to ask me and Lava some questions, but unfortunately we weren't able to help much.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: What? Is that weird Lateran fella still going around asking everyone what they know about Kazdel?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: He's not being discreet about it at all, huh... How many people has he asked by now?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: He's not seriously planning to take a little kid to Kazdel, is he? Does he have any clue how dangerous it is going around searching for someone with those two shiny targets above their heads?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Yeah, I also think it's way too dangerous!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: I really hope he manages to find some better way though...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: What are you discussing?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Oh, Mudrock!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: We were just talking about a Sankta guy who joined recently...

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Urk...!

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Please... let go...!

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: Why don't you shoot me in the gut? Is this all the resistance you can muster?

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: You want to go to Kazdel with that toy gun of yours? Who do you think is gonna be convinced by your high-minded ideas?

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Ungh!

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: (This overwhelming power... He's seriously going to kill me!)

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: If you want info, you can talk to the Vampire doctor, or maybe that Kal'tsit woman.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: If you have time to play Twenty Questions here, why not directly ask your superiors? How many of Laterano's missions do you think revolve around Kazdel anyway?

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: How many Sankta souls do you think this blade has gorged on?

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: I... *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: I appreciate the warning...

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: But I still hope... to hear the truth about Kazdel in your words.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: You should understand by now.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: I had my blade speak for me.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: Fool.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: *cough*... Wait! Hold on a second...

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: You don't get to ask me to wait, boy.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Why... didn't you kill me?

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: Life won't flourish without the right nutrients. The same's true for plants and people alike.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: Now scram, boy.

steps.name: Flamebringer
steps.text: You don't water flowers with blood.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: (That pure malice... He was absolutely ready to kill me just now...)

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: (Nothing I said... did any good at all. He didn't bat an eye at my words...)

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: (He even took the watering can with him when he left...)

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: So, that's a real Sarkaz.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Oww...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Are you sure you don't need me to bandage you up, Enforcer?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: You're still bleeding...

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: It's no big deal, just a scratch.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Flamebringer didn't actually do anything to me... Well, at least he didn't kill me outright.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Alright, the wound should be properly dressed now.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: I still have some arrangements to make, so I'll head out for now.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Huh? Wait, Enforcer!

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Did you need something else from me?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Even though personal conflicts are theoretically forbidden on Rhodes Island, not everyone is so disciplined...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: If you encounter a situation like that again, do your best to contact the Doctor, Amiya, or Dr. Kal'tsit directly.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Alright... Uhh, well, I'll see what I can do.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Most importantly...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: There are a number of Sarkaz operators in Rhodes Island who've had... certain experiences in the past. In your case, it might be extremely dangerous for you to try to approach them.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Please be careful.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Thank you for the advice. I know my conduct carries great risk.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: But, Rhodes Island... is likely the best and most suitable place I'm ever going to find to have these kinds of conversations. Isn't that right?

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Had I met Flamebringer under any other circumstance, I'm afraid I wouldn't be here to tell the tale.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Th-That's true, but...!

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: If I back down now, then the plan to go to Kazdel will fall apart.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: And I can't allow that. It hasn't gotten to the point yet where I have no choice but to give up.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: There's still one more person I should see...

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Excuse me.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Umm, are you... Mudrock?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: ...I am.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You know me... You came looking for me.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Yes, it may be presumptuous to say this on our first meeting. Nevertheless...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You're wounded.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: A fresh injury, caused by a sharp object. Just inflicted.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Did you run into someone on your way here?

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: That would be Flamebringer.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Yes... Makes sense.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Even at Rhodes Island, the Sankta are warned not to approach certain people. Some of us are dangerous, including Flamebringer, including myself.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Didn't the Doctor and Amiya tell you that?

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Yeah... The Doctor did try to talk me out of it.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: But you didn't listen.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I've heard you're gathering information about Kazdel. You're planning to take that girl to find someone.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: That's right. I came to you hoping to get some help...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I don't understand... Why are you so insistent on going there yourself?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You want to go to one of the most dangerous places for your kind, just the two of you Sankta... You should know how bad your idea is.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: I promised Cecelia that I'd take her to Kazdel to find her father. And I can't go back on my word.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: But I'm guessing that explanation won't satisfy you.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Hmm.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: I suppose it's like... going with the flow, in a way.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: I'm just an ordinary Sankta. If none of that stuff happened, the very idea of ever leaving Laterano probably would've never entered my head.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: I might've just been like everyone else, working and living a stable life, wanting for nothing, never having too many worries on my mind.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: And when I got older, I'd apply for retirement and live the rest of my days in peace and comfort, though it'd probably still get noisy every now and then.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Sounds like a good life.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: It is.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: But, when I started to see beyond the walls of Laterano, when I started coming into contact with viewpoints that are at odds with what I know, yet could not be denied...

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Then I, like any ordinary man, could no longer take that life for granted.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Cecelia gave me a chance. Honestly, I'm the one who needs to thank her.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Going to Kazdel isn't just a promise I made to her. It's also what I want to do.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: What you want to do?

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: I'd love to see Kazdel for myself, and witness the lives of the people there.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: That's the reason why I've come to you, Mudrock, ma'am.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: I... want to understand the Sarkaz, the people we've been locked in conflict with forever. I want to know... are we actually the same?

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: If we were born the same, what is it that divides us now?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: What is your plan?

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Ahaha... As much as I'd love to say that I've already devised a plan to do all that...

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: The truth is, I'm having a hard time even gathering info...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: That said, it's not like I haven't given it any thought at all. I just wouldn't call it a fully-fledged plan.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: In the case of Cecelia and myself, Kazdel is indeed difficult to enter, and us being Sankta only puts us on the back foot even more...

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: But, if we're talking about a mercenary who made it out of Kazdel...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: What do you mean...?

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: For example, a mercenary who was born in Kazdel, someone like you.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Say she went abroad to earn some money before going back home, and captured two Sankta prisoners along the way. That sounds pretty reasonable, doesn't it?

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Haha... Just an idea that popped into my head, Mudrock. Don't worry too much about it.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: It was only after meeting Flamebringer that I realized I haven't been taking this whole thing seriously enough.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: It sounds reasonable.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: If you make up your mind and decide to take the risk...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Your idea is reasonable and might be worth a shot.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Do you have the courage to try?

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: ...Of course.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: If I was afraid of taking risks, I never would've left Laterano.

steps.name: Enforcer
steps.text: Mudrock... Ma'am, can I ask you to help with this?
